actions.action: Check that the pot drains and empty any saucer or cache pot after watering
Move the plant to the brightest spot available without harsh afternoon sun
Keep the plant away from cold drafts from windows or vents
Check soil dryness and hold off watering until the top 2-3 inches are dry
Trim badly damaged leaves at the base of the stem
Check the stem bases for soft, black or mushy rot
If rot is found, unpot the plant and cut away the rotten parts
Mix in perlite or orchid bark to improve drainage if the soil stays wet

reason: The answer names light only as a secondary cause behind transplant stress and moisture, and buries the 'move to the brightest spot' fix, though the chunkier-mix suggestion matches what the poster did and nothing it recommends is harmful.
